claimPolicy: Only implementation_proved means correspondence to production code. Reference proofs, bounded models, static projections, and tests remain separately named evidence.

statusDefinitions.missing: No current evidence supports this layer of the exact obligation.
statusDefinitions.partial: Current evidence supports only a proper subset, abstraction, or unlinked reference for the exact obligation; the residual names the uncovered part.
statusDefinitions.tested: A production-bound executable path is exercised by one or more passing tests targeting the obligation; this never implies exhaustive state-space coverage or a theorem.
statusDefinitions.tested-under-simulation: A production-bound executable path is exercised through an explicitly bounded deterministic simulation at named adapter boundaries; it does not claim filesystem, OS, network, or scheduler semantics outside those boundaries.
statusDefinitions.executable_reference: A deterministic executable reference checks the stated behavior, but no production correspondence is claimed.
statusDefinitions.exhaustive_bounded: Every case in the explicitly declared finite input/state bound is enumerated; nothing outside that bound is claimed.
statusDefinitions.bounded_model_checked: An abstract transition model satisfies the stated invariant within the explicitly declared checker bound; neither unbounded validity nor implementation correspondence is claimed.
statusDefinitions.bounded_static_checked: Every artifact in an explicitly declared finite static corpus is checked; no claim is made outside that corpus.
statusDefinitions.reference_proved: A machine-checked theorem discharges the exact named obligation over the declared reference semantics without admitted proof holes; production correspondence is not claimed.
statusDefinitions.implementation_proved: A machine-checked correspondence argument binds the exact production implementation and representation to the proved semantics under declared assumptions.
statusDefinitions.deferred: This layer is deliberately outside the current verification profile and carries no positive assurance claim.
